title.narrative: Output 2.2. Increased capacity of Member States to apply international labour standards

description.narrative:
1. The ILO core labour standards were well reflected in the UN CCA and UNSDCF 2022-2026. These ILO core labour standards were mainstreamed throughout all 04 priority outcomes (1) inclusive social development (2) climate change response, disaster resilience and environmental suitability (4) governance and access to justice, of which the plan for study and ratification of C87 and addressing the ILO CEAR's comments on core ILS application were included.
2. As part of efforts for effectively implementing the UNSDCF's result framework, indicator 4.5 "Level of national compliance with the core labour rights, provision of feedback and taking actions toward addressing the CEACR's observation and direct requests on 1st report on C.98, were comprehensively made by the Government and in collaboration with the Social Partners 1. The ILO worked closely with MOLISA for the development and issuance of Decision No. 250 on studying and ratification of C87, including its Plan. 2. ILO reviewed and commented on the draft of the decree on Worker Representative Organisation on a version of the C87 Q&A booklet developed by the MOLISA 3. All 8 thematic reports on the basic contents of C87 and the draft gap analysis report have been reviewed carefully by the ILO with specific comments for finalization. 4. ILO developed and finalized the report on “Promoting and enforcing compliance of labour provisions in trade agreements: a comparative analysis of Canada, European Union, and United States approaches and practices” with several technical meetings and one consultation workshop in April 2022.

title.narrative: The ILO’s Results Framework for the biennium

description.narrative: The ILO’s Results Framework is always part of the Programme and Budget (P&B) document for the relevant biennium. Please refer to the Annex “Results Framework” of the relevant P&B Document

The ILO’s biennial Programme Implementation Report is an instrument of accountability. It describes the performance of the Organization against the commitments made in the Programme and Budget documents for the corresponding biennial period.
